subject: gk
question: India's support for which of the following missions aligns most closely with IMEC's purpose ?

options.text: One Sun One World One Grid initiative

solution:
The Correct answer is __**One Sun One World One Grid initiative**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **One Sun One World One Grid (OSOWOG) initiative** is an ambitious project launched by **India** to create a global interconnected solar energy grid.
 
• It is closely aligned with the purpose of **IMEC (India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor)**, which focuses on enhancing **connectivity and sustainable development.**
 
• The initiative aims to harness **solar energy** from regions with abundant sunlight and transmit it to areas with lower solar energy availability, promoting **clean and renewable energy.**
 
• The OSOWOG initiative supports the **International Solar Alliance (ISA)**, which is headquartered in **Gurugram, India**, and advocates for collaborative solar energy solutions.
 
• The grid aligns with IMEC's goals of fostering **economic growth, regional cooperation, and environmental sustainability** across continents.
 
• By connecting solar energy grids across regions, the initiative aims to reduce reliance on **fossil fuels**, lower **carbon emissions**, and achieve global **energy security.**
 
• India's leadership in OSOWOG highlights its commitment to **climate change mitigation** and the transition to a **low-carbon economy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **African Union's Blue Charter mission**__

 __
 
• This initiative focuses on sustainable management of **ocean resources** and combating **climate change** in African coastal areas.
 
• It primarily targets **marine conservation**, not renewable energy or global connectivity like OSOWOG.
 
 
 
• **Non-Aligned Movement's Neutrality Declaration**__
 __
 
• This declaration emphasizes **political neutrality** and non-alignment during global conflicts.
 
• It does not focus on energy or infrastructure projects.
 
 
 
• **International Solar Alliance energy initiative**__
 
 
• This initiative promotes **solar energy adoption** globally, but it focuses on individual member countries rather than a global interconnected grid.
 
• It complements OSOWOG but does not encompass its broader goal of creating a unified solar energy grid.
